# Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 30 (Bi-Vb Pc30)

**ID:** Bi-Vb Pc30
**Section:** Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga (bi-vb)
**Collection:** Vinaya
**Title (Pali):** Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 30
**Title (English, from literature):** Blocking the ending of the robe season
**tipitaka.org (CST):** https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/vin02m1.mul7.xml

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Kathinuddhāra-sikkhāpada* (Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 30) governs the formal termination of the robe-making season (*kaṭhina*) within the nuns' community [Hüsken 1997]. The rule establishes that a nun who inappropriately hinders or obstructs the monastic community from ending the robe-making period commits an expiable offense (*pācittiya*) [Hüsken 1997]. In the canonical origin narrative found at Vinaya IV 288, the nun Thullanandā prevents this legal procedure (*kammavācā*) from proceeding, an episode examined in Buddhaghosa's *Samantapāsādikā* (Sp 931) regarding valid and invalid grounds for terminating or delaying the *kaṭhina* privileges [Hüsken 1997]. An English translation has been produced by Bhikkhu Brahmali.

Full parallels are preserved in the Pali *Bhikkhunī Pātimokkha* (pc 30) and the *Bhikkhunī Parivāra* (Pācittiya 30), as well as across other early Vinaya traditions in Chinese translation, including the Dharmaguptaka (Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Pc 109 and Pātimokkha Pc 109) and Sarvāstivāda (Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Pc 136 and Pātimokkha Pc 136).
